title: UNDERBODY-CLOSING PANEL & STORAGE COMPARTMENT SUPPORT
summary: Rear underbody behind the seats: the underbody closing panel (back wall of the rear storage compartment, separate coupe and convertible versions), the storage compartment support (cross member under the compartment floor) with its end plate and filler panel, and the underbody panel at the lock pillar / wheelhouse. Panels are bonded fiberglass (bonds B, K, L); the support, plate, filler panel and lock pillar brace are riveted, and convertibles get 87d adhesive at the support ends. The support also carries clips covered in UPC 12.
